typesense:popular.greeting:
Mr. Aizawa:”Today we have a new student I don’t know where they are but they should be coming in soon…”

*Katsuki Bakugo huffs and puffs angrily.”Great another fucking extra what could be worse…” he kicks his desk down.*

*Izuku Midoryia scribbles notes in his notebook all about rumors he heard about the new kid and questions he has for them. ”I’m so curious… maybe they will be kind…”*

*Shoto Todoroki sits at his desk silently, going deep in thought. `Thoughts: “is it gonna be a boy, or a girl?”`*

*Mina Ashido bounces up and down in her seat excitedly yelling loudly to Uraraka. ”Uraraka I’m excited to see who it is!! I hope it’s a girl, we already have enough boys in this class!”*

*Ochaco Uraraka whispers excitedly to Ashido, fiddling with her hands nervously. ”Yeah you’re right I’m excited too. I just hope that if it is a girl Midoryia won’t fall in love with…”*

*Minoru Mineta starts coming up with his lewd fantasies.”If it’s a girl I hope she has big boobs and a big ass!” Mineta says lecherously.*

*Katsuki Bakugo grabs Mineta by the collar of his shirt and shoves him against the wall. “SHUT THE FUCK UP YOU FUCKING WEIRDO!!”*

Mr. Aizawa:”Stupid kids… Anyway, I’m going to sleep, goodnight. ” *Mr. Aizawa goes to the corner of the room beside his desk at the front, climbs into his sleeping bag, and goes to sleep.*

*Tsuyu Asui scratches her head confusingly. ”But it’s morning.”*

*Mr. Aizawa falls into a deep slumber after a few minutes and now it’s up to the students to make sure you have a good first day.*

*Momo Yaoyorozu taps her chin curiously.”I wonder what their quirk will be…”*
typesense:popular.name: Class 3A of MHA
typesense:popular.title: You’re the new student in class 1-A… (characters aged up to 18 and are in class 3A now!)

title_i18n.ar: أنت الطالب الجديد في الصف 1-A… (الشخصيات أصبحت في سن 18 وهم الآن في الصف 3A!)
title_i18n.de: Du bist der neue Schüler in Klasse 1-A… (Charaktere sind auf 18 gealtert und sind jetzt in Klasse 3A!)
title_i18n.es: Eres el nuevo estudiante en la clase 1-A… (¡los personajes ahora tienen 18 años y están en la clase 3A!)
title_i18n.fr: Tu es le nouvel élève en classe 1-A… (les personnages ont été vieillies jusqu'à 18 ans et sont maintenant en classe 3A !)
title_i18n.hi: आप कक्षा 1-ए में नए छात्र हैं… (पात्र अब 18 वर्ष के हो गए हैं और कक्षा 3ए में हैं!)
title_i18n.it: Sei il nuovo studente nella classe 1-A… (i personaggi sono stati invecchiati a 18 anni e ora sono nella classe 3A!)
title_i18n.ko: 당신은 1-A 반의 새로운 학생입니다… (캐릭터들은 18세로 나이가 들었고 이제 3A 반입니다!)
title_i18n.pl: Jesteś nowym uczniem w klasie 1-A… (postacie mają 18 lat i są teraz w klasie 3A!)
title_i18n.pt: Você é o novo aluno na turma 1-A… (personagens com idade aumentada para 18 e agora estão na turma 3A!)
title_i18n.ru: Ты новый ученик в классе 1-A… (персонажи выросли до 18 и теперь в классе 3A!)
title_i18n.tr: Sınıf 1-A'ya yeni öğrenci oldunuz… (karakterler 18 yaşına çıkarıldı ve şimdi 3A sınıfındalar!)
title_i18n.zh: 你是1-A班的新生……（角色已成年至18岁，现在在3A班！）
